content.text:
Resubmitted with the verifier's repairs incorporated.

**Changes from the prior submission:**
1. **Express section number** — the inserted clause now carries "Section 7.7 Termination for Convenience." in its own text so it sits in the Article VII sequence rather than rendering as an unnumbered heading.
2. **Customer identification in operative language** — the clause now reads "The Issuer, as the customer for the Servicer's services, may terminate this Agreement ... for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice", removing the alias ambiguity that produced the deterministic "Customer convenience termination present: failed" result while keeping the right unconditional.
3. **Conforming edit to Section 8.3** — a five-word surgical change ("earlier" → "earliest to occur of a termination under Section 7.7,") so the apparently exhaustive natural-expiry list no longer competes with the new exit. All of clauses (a) and (b) are retained verbatim, and the edit is within the word-growth limit.

**Unchanged and deliberate:** preferred level (not fallback, which would concede a Servicer term-end exit that Section 7.1 currently forecloses); element 4 mapped as already_met on retained Section 7.1; no "in whole or in part", no survival tail, expense, or procedural boilerplate; Sections 7.1, 7.2(c), 7.3 and 7.4 untouched.
